output.sql: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.email, AVG(e.grade) AS avg_grade, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(e.grade) DESC) AS rank FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id WHERE e.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.email ORDER BY avg_grade DESC LIMIT 3
